purpose: These three sequences separate the three put conflict modes, the presence/absence of the AFTER INSERT trigger, and the three channel definitions. The first sequence distinguishes INSERT OR IGNORE from INSERT OR REPLACE / ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE via committed count and sum. The second sequence distinguishes trigger firing on ignored inserts and rollback effects on total_changes versus changes(). The third sequence distinguishes main-only total_changes from main+other total_changes and separates REPLACE from DO UPDATE when the other connection writes after a committed main transaction.
